qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.Tech/M.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering and B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering with minimum 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA) OR B.Tech/B.E. degree in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering and related streams with minimum 60% marks (or 6.5/10.0 CGPA) throughout from Class XII. Valid GATE/NET preferred. Research Associate-III (RA-III): Ph.D. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering with B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering from a recognized University/Institute OR M.Tech/M.E. degree in Mechanical/Chemical/Computer Science & Engineering with three years of research, teaching and design and development experience with at least one research paper in SCI journal.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate-III positions at IIT Jammu is 22 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by IIT Jammu for the positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Associate-III (RA-III). This includes one JRF post and two RA-III posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position, candidates need an M.Tech/M.E. or B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Chemical, or Computer Science & Engineering with at least 60% marks. A valid GATE/NET score is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-III (RA-III) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-III (RA-III) post is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and the project's requirements. This is followed by an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) will receive a stipend of INR 37,000/- plus 20% HRA for the first two years, and INR 42,000/- plus 20% HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Research Associate-III (RA-III) post?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-III (RA-III) will be offered a salary of INR 67,000/- plus 20% HRA. This is a consolidated salary for the contractual position.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Associate-III (RA-III) at IIT Jammu are contractual in nature. This means the employment is for a fixed term as specified in the appointment letter.
